hints.title: Pairing Simultaneous Sessions
hints.text: Join the log records to themselves matching on account identity while ensuring distinct IP addresses.

hints.title: Detecting Temporal Overlap
hints.text: Filter pairs where session intervals overlap by ensuring login of one session is between login and logout of the other.

hints.title: Deduplicating Account Identifiers
hints.text: Use distinct on the account identifier to return each offending account once.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM LogInfo a
JOIN LogInfo b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
  AND a.ip_address <> b.ip_address
  AND a.login <= b.logout
  AND a.logout >= b.login;
```

complexity.time: O(N^2) worst case per account, O(N log N) with index on (account_id, login)
complexity.notes: Self-join on overlapping time intervals with differing network addresses.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries or repeated scans can be quadratic without index pruning on account identifiers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filtering on differing IP addresses prunes symmetrical pairs efficiently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should correctly state interval overlap conditions (a.start <= b.end and a.end >= b.start).
